Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ ابْتَلَيْتَنَا فِيْ أَرْزَاقِنَا بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ
Translation: O Allah, You have tested us in our sustenance with evil thoughts
And in our lifespans with long hopes

Arabic text: حَتَّى الْتَمَسْنَا أَرْزَاقَكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ
Translation: Until we seek Your sustenance from those who are themselves sustained
And we covet with our hopes the lifespans of the long-lived
So bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لَنَا يَقِينًا صَادِقًا تَكْفِينَا بِهِ مِنْ مَؤونَةِ الطَّلَبِ
Translation: And grant us true certainty by which You spare us the burden of seeking

Arabic text: وَأَلْهِمْنَا ثِقَةً خَالِصَةً تُعْفِينَا بِهَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ النَّصَبِ
Translation: And inspire us with pure trust by which You relieve us from the hardship of toil

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ مَا صَرَّحْتَ بِهِ مِنْ عِدَتِكَ فِيْ وَحْيِكَ
Translation: And make what You have declared of Your promise in Your revelation
And followed it with Your oaths in Your Book

Arabic text: قَاطِعًا لِاهْتِمَامِنَا بِالرِّزْقِ الَّـذِيْ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِهِ
Translation: A means to end our anxiety about the sustenance which You have guaranteed

Arabic text: وَحَسْمًا لِلْإِشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ
Translation: And a way to cease our preoccupation with that which You have assured sufficiency
For You have said - and Your word is the truest and most honest
And You have sworn - and Your oath is the most righteous and most fulfilling
"And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised"

Arabic text: ثُمَّ قُلْتَ فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْاَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ
Translation: Then You said, "So by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking"
